note: Text budgets per box variant, px of drawn text from the pen origin on one line, measured in-game from the marker/ruler build (docs/re/width.md). `measured` means the recorded shot demonstrates either the clip limit or an explicitly documented conservative lower bound; false means inferred geometry requiring measurement. Strict phase-7 lint rejects every changed line without a measured budget. Optional bytes constrains a native text-copy buffer independently of pixels.
tables_note: Which box each string id (`EEEE_NAME:IIII`, `a9:XXXXXXXX`) is drawn in; first match wins (tools/lint.py). Optional condition: mod = [m, r] on the string index, jp = regex on the Japanese. `dev` = developer menus and test rooms (not reachable in the release, not linted for width).

font.advance_rule: pen += CWDH advance + 1 px; tools/font.py sets ASCII advance = ink width, space = 3

char_desc.reason: Unused character-description record field +8 and unreferenced pool default 2; the displayed skill descriptions come from CHARTABLE +4. Exact ID set is checked against the pinned ROM's 147 records, stride 0x24.

unit_desc.reason: Unused unit-description field +8 and pool default 2. Native 145 can return descriptions for selector 2, but all three script calls use selectors 0/1. Displayed weapon descriptions come from CHARTABLE +4. Exact IDs are checked against 141 records, stride 0x34.

series_name.reason: LEVELTABLE pool IDs 0..5 have no rendering consumer: record accessor 02043088 has only initializer caller 02042e70; pool ID 0 is unreferenced.

hidden_map_debug.reason: Exact addresses consumed only by hidden map-debug routines. The release menu stops at item 4; entering 02032890 requires item 5. Separate individual-debug labels 02072758 and 02072a34 are deliberately not excluded.

one_icon_footer.note: Conservative demonstrated bound for exact callers of 0204d218 that populate only icon slot 0 (x192). Do not apply to multi-icon footers. Caller evidence: docs/re/width-callers.md.

extras.note: Conservative demonstrated lower bound: a full 31-digit ruler (177 px with the narrow 1 glyph) is visible in the title strip and bottom help strip. This is not a claim that the strip clips at 177 px.

extras_button.note: Conservative bound for medium buttons (MAKERLOGO setup mode 1). The ruler has 114 px of visible ink at x73..186; 112 px leaves a margin. Title menu uses the same setup mode; the wider extras main-menu mode 2 also uses this smaller limit. Sound submenu now uses mode 1 via tools/layout.py.

stage_name_list.note: Same names as STnnSTAGE string 351; use the smallest measured prep/map name bar (stage_names lint), not the wider chart card.

sound_list.note: Extras music and SFX lists: centred ruler clipped at x48..207. Full-table ruler stress build coverage_all; 1200 frames after cold-boot warp.

gallery_list.note: Extras battle and event gallery lists: centred ruler clipped at x48..207. Developer viewers have wider labels; use the player's narrower list.

stage_card_narration.note: Stage card narration (BBQ tables 0085 BTLDIR and the per-stage <NNN>STAGE tables): 30 digits at 6 px fill it. The card types the text on, so a shot must run >= 1200 frames after the warp (at the default 300 the third line is still mid-type).

menu_row.note: Command row and header share a 128 px surface (mode 3, width table 02070d04; construction 02024dd4-02024e70). Ruler reaches x64..191. The earlier 130 px claim assumed constant-width digits; 22 current digits advance 123 px and 23 advance 129 px. See docs/re/width-callers.md.

chart_footer_hint.note: The arm9 hint on the lower screen's status strip (ステージを選択); it is clipped where the B button starts.

prep_condition_row.note: Victory/defeat condition rows on the battle-brief screen (centred text). Guessed from the panel geometry.

stage_info_panel.note: Upper-screen stage-info panel labels (stage name, turn counter); centred, so the marker's id can be pushed out of the box when the text is longer than the field.

list_row.note: Generic list rows (extras, load, options, sysflags, movie viewers). Guessed: several of these are wider than menu_row.

char_name.note: Budgets here are tools/fit.py px (ink + the renderer's 1 px gap per glyph), so ink width + 1. Character full name (SETABLE index %3 == 0). Team-edit panel (X on the map): the left panel clips at x=124 (117 px from x=8); the character-info screen (Y) is wider (160 px). Stress build tools/stress.py 3:3=@ruler.

skill_name.note: Character skill / weapon name (CHARTABLE names): clipped at x=110 on the character-info screen and the team panel (same 103 px both).

info_desc.note: Skill / weapon description lines (CHARTABLE descriptions, \n = second line): run to the screen edge (x=255) on the character-info and unit-info screens. $L counts 2 digits, $Pnn 3.

unit_name.note: Unit name (SKILLTABLE odd index): team panel clips at x=124 like char_name; unit-info screen 160 px.

faction.note: Faction name bar on the map's stage-info panel (UNITTABLE), centred in x 144-253.

team_cmd.note: Map team-command buttons (合流/編成/攻撃 beside 移動/情報): text centred, clipped both sides at ~28 px ("Organize" showed as "rganiz", "Info" 20 px whole).

terrain_cell.note: Terrain cell (地形属性) under AREA INFO on the map panel, centred, clips at x 144-199 (ruler 7:4=@ruler shows D..M whole). `Underwater` (fit.px 57 = 56 ink) draws x 144-198 with every glyph whole (stress 7:4=Underwater, map warp).

area_info.note: Conservative lower bound from a fully visible 31-digit ruler (177 px) in the AREA INFO name bar. A longer alphabetic ruler runs into the adjacent Ranged field after 32 bytes: preserve a NUL within the 32-byte copy. Do not treat that overread as a legitimate terrain suffix.

story_dialogue.note: Portrait message window on the lower screen (MILITARY tables, stage-intro dialogue): reached by warping st01_open and mashing A ~5250 frames. A 40-digit ruler (tools/mark.py --ruler 40 --only MILITARY) clips at ink x=183 (x 9-183), the same 180 px line buffer as the stage card; 3 lines at y 336/348/360.
